robots.simple.intro: Create a work area from your rooms and choose the device that will clean it.
robots.simple.empty: No work areas yet. Start with New.
robots.simple.draw: New work area · Select and edit surfaces
robots.simple.deleteConfirm: Delete this work area? Your rooms and device settings will be kept.
robots.flow.steps: 1 · Robot and floor → 2 · Area → 3 · Align maps → 4 · Review and start
robots.flow.savedTitle: Work areas saved — your next step
robots.flow.autoAssignment: HomeTwin links this robot to the current floor automatically and reuses existing map settings.
robots.flow.chooseArea: Select or create a work area.
robots.flow.align: Next: align this floor with the robot map.
robots.flow.ready: Ready to preview the cleaning area.
robots.flow.unsupported: Planning only: zone cleaning is not implemented for this integration.
robots.align.title: Align floor and robot map
robots.align.instructions: Load your robot map, then select the same three widely separated corners in both views. The points must not lie on one line. No robot command is sent.
robots.align.pickHome: Point {number}: choose a corner on your floor plan.
robots.align.pickMap: Point {number}: choose the matching corner on the robot map.
robots.align.review: Three pairs selected. Check the map before applying.
robots.align.noImage: Load a map with coordinate calibration to begin.
robots.align.confirmHint: The map must belong to this robot and floor. Align again after remapping.
robots.align.confirm: Robot and floor are correct; the three points match.
robots.align.metadata: The map has no valid calibration_points metadata. Enable it in your map integration and reload. Manual coordinates remain under Advanced map settings.
robots.align.failed: Could not load the robot map. Check the map entity in Home Assistant and try again.
robots.title: Robots & work areas
robots.intro: Use your existing floors to define robot work areas. Draw garden areas and property boundaries separately. Device support determines which actions are available.
robots.needsFloor: Create at least one floor with a room first.
robots.drawingHint: Click a room. Hold Shift or Ctrl to add or remove rooms, or enable Multiple selection on touch screens. Draw additional shapes anywhere; Draw exclusion cuts holes in your selection.
robots.name: Name
robots.localOnly: These markings are saved in HomeTwin. They are not uploaded as device boundaries. Overlapping exclusions and lines block zone cleaning here.
robots.floorHint: Create one assignment per device and floor/map. This name is a reference only; HomeTwin does not switch the active robot map or move the robot between floors.
robots.zoneSupport: Xiaomi rectangular zone cleaning is supported. Calibration is required.
robots.unsupported: This device can be assigned, but transferring areas and starting work from them is not supported yet.
robots.calibrationHint: Enter three matching, non-collinear points from your HomeTwin floor (metres) and the robot map (millimetres). Use known map coordinates, not image pixels. Recalibrate after remapping. The scale must be close to 1000 mm per metre.
robots.noUpload: Saving only stores HomeTwin areas and assignments. It does not replace the robot navigation map or start cleaning. Calibrated Xiaomi areas can be sent as up to five exact rectangles after preview and confirmation.
robots.confirmHint: Coordinates above are in robot-map millimetres. This starts physical movement. Check the area against the robot map before continuing.
robots.confirmFloor: I checked the coordinates, the robot is on this floor and this map is active.
robots.draftHint: Save your changes before previewing a command. Your house geometry stays unchanged.
robots.discard: Discard unsaved changes to work areas?
robots.conflict: The plan changed. Close and reopen this section before saving or sending.
robots.invalidArea: Use a valid polygon without crossing edges, or a line with at least two distinct points.
robots.loadError: Could not load robot entities. Reopen this section to retry.
robots.sent: Home Assistant accepted the command. Check the device for progress.
robots.sendFailed: The command could not be confirmed. Check the robot state before trying again; it may already have started.
robots.error.unsupported: This device does not support Xiaomi zone cleaning.
robots.error.zone: Choose an indoor work area and an assignment for the same floor.
robots.error.mapName: Enter the device map name or ID first.
robots.error.calibration: Enter three valid matching map points with a consistent metre-to-millimetre scale.
robots.error.excluded: This work area overlaps an exclusion or a boundary line. Adjust it before starting.
robots.error.rectangle: Xiaomi zones must be rectangles aligned with the robot map axes. This shape cannot be sent without changing its outline.
robots.error.bounds: The zone is outside the supported 0–51200 mm range or smaller than 100 mm.
robots.legend: Click a room to select it. Green dashed lines mark doors/passages; blue lines are windows. Door symbols show the plan, not the current door state.
robots.selectionCount: {number} rooms selected. Add shapes or draw exclusions before adding the area.
robots.applyFirst: Add your selection as an area and finish drawing before saving.
robots.error.tooManyZones: This shape needs more than five rectangular zones, is empty, or is too complex. Split it into smaller work areas.
